note: Recast from the redescription of the soldier of Thai specimens by Ahmad (1965), original in English; the original records the soldier only; figure 46 is not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown to chestnut brown; mandibles deep reddish brown; antenna pale, the apical segments concolorous with the basal ones; pronotum paler than the head. Head with a few scattered bristles; labrum with several bristles along the two lateral margins; postmentum with 4 bristles on the anterior half; pronotum with a few scattered bristles on the margins and the disc. Head slightly rectangular, sides weakly convex, narrowing very gradually anteriorly; labrum dome-shaped, longer than wide, apex broadly rounded; mandibles sickle-shaped, left mandible with a sharp forward-pointing tooth in the apical third, right mandible with an indistinct tooth anterior to the middle. Postmentum about 2 times as long as wide, widest in the apical third; antenna 15 segments, segment 2 twice as long as 3 and 1.5 times as long as 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum convex without a notch, lateral lobes broadly rounded, posterior margin concave. Measurements of 5 soldiers: head length (to the lateral mandible base) 1.11—1.24 (mean 1.19) mm, head width (at the lateral mandible base) 0.62—0.67 (0.63) mm, head width at the posterior end of the antennal carina 0.78—0.88 (0.83) mm, maximum head width 0.83—0.93 (0.89) mm, left mandible length 0.57—0.62 (0.60) mm, distance from the left mandibular tooth to the apex 0.18—0.20 (0.18) mm, postmentum length 0.65—0.78 (0.72) mm, postmentum width 0.33—0.37 (0.35) mm, pronotum length 0.33—0.39 (0.36) mm, pronotum width 0.54—0.67 (0.62) mm.
